parsed.notes: The Credit Agreement (Third Amended and Restated, $300M revolver maturing June 30, 2031) requires a minimum interest coverage ratio and a maximum Net Leverage Ratio, but the excerpt gives neither the required levels nor the actual values. It says only that the company is in compliance, so no ratio entries are reported. The 2.5 to 1 Net Leverage Ratio is excluded because it is a pro forma test that limits dividends and distributions, not a maintenance covenant. Net Leverage Ratio is also used to set the interest margin and commitment fee, which is excluded as a pricing ratio. There were no borrowings outstanding at September 26, 2026.
